title: The Canteen
setting: 1:15pm Monday. The canteen on the third floor. Karthik's already at a corner table with a plate of something that's gone slightly orange. He waves you over and pushes the bench out.

beats.native: ಬಾಸ್! Friday ride ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ತಲೆನೋವು ಇಲ್ಲ ತಾನೇ?
beats.translit: bās! Friday ride hēgittu? talenōvu illa tānē?
beats.en: Boss! How was the Friday ride? No headache, hopefully?
beats.beat: mouth half full, not even pretending to wait until he's done

choices.native: Survive ಆದೆ. Saturday ಪೂರ್ತಿ sleep. Today Monday ಆಗಿದ್ದು ನಿಜ ತಾನೇ?
choices.translit: survive āde. Saturday pūrti sleep. today Monday āgiddu nija tānē?
choices.en: Survived. Slept all Saturday. Today's really Monday, right?
Made it. Barely. Thanks for the dark ale education.

beats.native: Ha! ಸರಿ — ಈಗ floor politics. ನೋಡು ಅಲ್ಲಿ — grey shirt, glasses? ಅವನು Suresh ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್. ಎಲ್ಲರ ಜೊತೆ smile. ಎಲ್ಲರ ಜೊತೆ daily one-on-one. ಆದರೆ promotion list ನಲ್ಲಿ — ಅವನ favourite ಮಾತ್ರ.
beats.translit: ha! sari — īga floor politics. nōḍu alli — grey shirt, glasses? avanu Suresh manager. ellara joḍe smile. ellara joḍe daily one-on-one. ādare promotion list-nalli — avana favourite mātra.
beats.en: Ha! Okay — floor politics. See over there — grey shirt, glasses? That's Suresh manager. Smiles at everyone. One-on-ones with everyone daily. But on the promotion list — only his favourite.

beats.native: Eeshwari ma'am — pink dupatta, near the window. ಅವಳು ಒಳ್ಳೆ. Honest feedback. ಅವಳ team ಗೆ try ಮಾಡು after probation.
beats.translit: Eeshwari ma'am — pink dupatta, near the window. avaḷu oḷḷe. honest feedback. avaḷa team-ge try māḍu after probation.
beats.en: Eeshwari ma'am — pink dupatta, by the window. She's good. Honest feedback. Try to get on her team after probation.
beats.beat: spears a fritter, eats half of it in one bite

choices.native: Eeshwari ma'am team ಗೆ ಹೋಗೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? Suresh ಗೆ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಾ?
choices.translit: Eeshwari ma'am team-ge hōgōdu hēge? Suresh-ge hēḷabēkā?
choices.en: How do you get on Eeshwari ma'am's team? Do I tell Suresh?
Got it. I'll keep my head down till probation.
What kind of work does Suresh's team do?

beats.native: Suresh ಗೆ ಹೇಳಬೇಡ. ಯಾವತ್ತೂ ಹೇಳಬೇಡ. ಒಂದು project ತೆಗೆದುಕೋ, ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡು, Eeshwari ಗೆ visible ಆಗು. ಅದು ದಾರಿ.
beats.translit: Suresh-ge hēḷabēḍa. yāvattū hēḷabēḍa. ondu project tegedukō, cennāgi māḍu, Eeshwari-ge visible āgu. adu dāri.
beats.en: Don't tell Suresh. Never tell Suresh. Take one project, do it well, become visible to Eeshwari. That's the way.
beats.beat: for the first time, no joke in it

beats.native: Anyway. Friday's drinks ನನ್ನ — Saturday housewarming forget ಮಾಡಬೇಡ. ಎಂಟು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ. Karthik ride.
beats.translit: anyway. Friday's drinks nanna — Saturday housewarming forget māḍabēḍa. eṇṭu gaṇṭege. Karthik ride.
beats.en: Anyway — Friday's drinks were mine. Don't forget the housewarming Saturday. Eight pm. I'll pick you up.
beats.beat: drains his glass, claps a hand on the table
